title: Reverse Bits
kidExplanation: Picture the puzzle 'Reverse Bits'. Here is the clever trick in plain words: To reverse the bits of a given unsigned integer, we can iterate through each bit of the input number. For each bit, we use bitwise operations to reverse the bit and append it to the result. We will still start slow, then use this trick so it becomes fast.
plainProblem: Reverse Bits: Picture the puzzle 'Reverse Bits'. Worked example — input: n = 000...00101; expected output: reversed 32-bit. Why: Bit reverse. Interview pattern to name out loud: Bit tricks (AND/OR/XOR).
